subject: Request: vulnerability management evidence and remediation attestation
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com>

Cc: security@orchidhealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SOC2 SIG submission

Hi Kimberly,

We're compiling our SIG + SOC2 evidence and need Redwood's vulnerability management artifacts for our assessor. Specifically we need the following by next Monday (2025-07-28):

- Recent authenticated network/app scan export (last 90 days)
- CSV of CVE closure history for Q2 2025 (including ticket refs and remediation dates)
- Your SLA/commitment for time-to-remediate by severity and how exceptions are handled
- A short signed attestation from Redwood leadership confirming cadence and coverage for externally facing services

Can you confirm you can provide these items and an estimated delivery time? If there's a preferred upload location for large files (S3/Drive) please send.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Security Engineer, Orchid Health
alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

Quick plan: I'll assemble the attestation and coordinate upload. Karthik will pull the scan exports and the CSV. Marissa (CSE) will handle delivery details and any doc formats you prefer.

Can you confirm you need authenticated (credentialed) scan exports vs. unauthenticated? Also confirm whether the assessor needs proof of remediation verification (evidence that fixes were deployed) vs. just ticket/closure metadata. We'll aim to deliver an initial bundle by EOD Tue 2025-07-22 and final signed attestation by Mon 2025-07-28 unless you need it sooner.

—Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: VM evidence for SOC2 SIG submission

Folks — forwarding Orchid's request. Action items: 

- Karthik: export authenticated scan results for the past 90 days covering externally facing infra + control plane; include scan run metadata (tool, auth creds used, scan policy) and the raw findings CSV/PDF.
- Karthik: produce CVE closure CSV for Q2 2025 with columns: CVE, affected component, ticket id, initial discovery date, remediation date, remediation notes, verification method.
- Marissa: coordinate a Drive upload and send Alex a DocuSign link for the attestation once Kimberly provides the draft.
- Kimberly (me): draft a short attestation (1 page) stating scan cadence (weekly authenticated scans for public endpoints, monthly internal scans, triage SLA), sign-off line for leadership.

Constraints / notes: we may have a small number of exceptions on legacy infra that require compensating controls; include exception IDs and approved mitigation where relevant. If any remediation exceeds our stated SLAs we'll include root cause + mitigation plan.

Target: initial bundle for Orchid by 2025-07-22 EOD. Ping me in Slack if you need to accelerate.

—Kim

On Mon, 21 Jul 2025 at 10:18 AM, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Orchid's request. Action items: 

We're good to provide the exports. Attaching the primary scan PDF and the raw CVE closure CSV for Q2 as a first pass. Highlights and formal commitments below.

Commitments (operational SLA):
- P1 / Critical: 30 calendar days to remediation or documented compensating control with interim mitigation; emergency hotfix windows available for customer-impacting incidents.
- P2 / High: 60 calendar days to remediation or compensating control documented and tracked.
- P3 / Medium: 120 calendar days to remediation with prioritization by risk.

Notes on verification: remediation is validated via either (a) redeployment + post-patch authenticated scan, or (b) an internal verification checklist with evidence links (change ticket, pipeline run id). For replaced/retired components we include decommission proofs.

Exceptions & escalation: exceptions must be approved by Security + Infrastructure owners and are tracked in our exception registry (Exception-ID column included in CSV). We will include exception summaries where applicable.

I'll include the following attachments in the Drive folder: vm-scan-report-2025-04.pdf, cve-closure-log-2025Q2.csv. Kimberly — draft the attestation and I will review the technical wording.

—Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vm-scan-report-2025-04.pdf; cve-closure-log-2025Q2.csv

Alex — attaching the requested artifacts and the signed attestation. Links below (we uploaded the exports to a secured Drive folder and added a DocuSign option for the attestation):

- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link
- Attestation (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-DOCUSIGN-ID

Attachments included: vm-scan-report-2025-04.pdf (authenticated external scan export), cve-closure-log-2025Q2.csv (CVE closure history w/ exception IDs), vm-attestation-2025-07.docx (signed by Head of Security).

Summary of commitments (excerpted):
- Weekly authenticated scans of externally facing services; monthly internal scans.
- P1 / Critical: 30 calendar day target to remediation or documented compensating control; P2: 60 days; P3: 120 days.
- Exceptions tracked in our registry with owner and mitigation; remediation verification via post-patch scan or change artifacts.

If your assessor needs any additional contextual notes or a SOC2-specific mapping sheet, we can produce a short matrix mapping these artifacts to SIG/SOC2 control identifiers. Let me know the assessor's preference.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a call if the assessor wants to walk the artifacts.

Best,
Kimberly Park
